name: hope
description: Review immutable local Git commits as evidence-linked offline HTML alongside Hope's intent, maintenance, review, PR explanation, and writing skills. Requires Node.js 22 or newer.

interface.shortDescription: Review one Git commit as a grounded offline HTML artifact
interface.longDescription: Commit Diff reads one immutable local Git commit, compares it with a selected parent, and produces an evidence-linked offline HTML review without reading worktree changes. This unofficial fork retains Hope's Align, Sweep, Toxic Review, Diff, and Write skills.
defaultPrompt: Use $hope:commit to review this commit as offline HTML.
Use $hope:align to build a shared understanding before implementation.
Use $hope:sweep to remove proven codebase waste without changing customer-observed behavior.
Use $hope:diff to explain the current pull request.
